title: Freedom movement sites
blurb: Where the revolt of 1857, the Congress years and the Gandhian movements happened.
source: Public facts (places and dates), listed by hand with the notes written for this site; positions taken from Wikidata where it has the place
licence: Facts, no copyright; positions from Wikidata (CC0)

items.name: Meerut
items.detail: 10 May 1857: the sepoys' revolt begins here and spreads to Delhi.

items.name: Delhi
items.detail: Bahadur Shah Zafar is declared leader of the revolt; the British retake the city in September 1857.

items.name: Jhansi
items.detail: Rani Lakshmibai defends the fort against the British in 1858.

items.name: Kanpur
items.detail: Held by Nana Sahib's rebels in 1857.

items.name: Lucknow
items.detail: The siege of the Residency in 1857; Begum Hazrat Mahal leads the rebels.

items.name: Barrackpore
items.detail: Mangal Pandey's mutiny, March 1857.

items.name: Mumbai
items.detail: 1885: the first session of the Indian National Congress. The Quit India resolution of 1942 was also passed here.

items.name: Kolkata
items.detail: 1905: the partition of Bengal and the Swadeshi movement.

items.name: Surat
items.detail: 1907: the Congress splits into Moderates and Extremists.

items.name: Champaran
items.detail: 1917: Gandhi's first satyagraha in India, for the indigo farmers.

items.name: Kheda
items.detail: 1918: a satyagraha for tax relief after a failed harvest.

items.name: Ahmedabad
items.detail: 1918: the mill workers' strike; Gandhi's Sabarmati Ashram stands here.

items.name: Amritsar
items.detail: 13 April 1919: the Jallianwala Bagh massacre.

items.name: Chauri Chaura
items.detail: 1922: a mob burns a police station and Gandhi calls off the Non-Cooperation Movement.

items.name: Kakori
items.detail: 1925: the train robbery by the Hindustan Republican Association.

items.name: Bardoli
items.detail: 1928: the peasants' tax refusal led by Vallabhbhai Patel.

items.name: Dandi
items.detail: 1930: the Salt March from Sabarmati ends here and the Civil Disobedience Movement begins.

items.name: Vedaranyam
items.detail: 1930: C. Rajagopalachari's salt march from Tiruchirappalli ends here.

items.name: Payyannur
items.detail: 1930: the salt march from Calicut led by K. Kelappan ends here.

items.name: Wardha
items.detail: Gandhi's base from 1936, at Sevagram nearby.

items.name: Pune
items.detail: The Aga Khan Palace, where Gandhi was held after the Quit India resolution of 1942.

items.name: Moirang
items.detail: 1944: the Indian National Army raises its flag on Indian soil here.

items.name: Port Blair
items.detail: The Cellular Jail held political prisoners.
